comment: VRAM copy regions of sprite12 for docs/ROM_LAYOUT.md: [char0, 16-word chunk count] in descriptor order. The tile regions (values are genroms.py SPRITE_SCENES) and the SG pattern block (cell $80, 64 cells = 4096 words at VRAM $2000 — one 16x16 pattern per SAT entry). Read by tools/genviewer.py and renderer/pce-rom.js (#14); the SAT at VRAM $7f00 is NOT a region - it has its own fixed place in bank 1 (docs/ROM_LAYOUT.md). #42's scene: 64 sprites, one per SAT entry, entries 20-63 live (REVIEW-14 break A2).
